suppress.notes: False positive: CVE-2026-53914 is unsafe deserialization in Kotlin Gradle plugin build-cache metadata (org.jetbrains.kotlin:kotlin-gradle-plugin before 2.4.20). This Java library does not apply the Kotlin Gradle plugin. kotlin-stdlib is a transitive of OkHttp/Okio, version-managed by Spring Boot 4.1.1 (2.3.21). See GHSA-r937-wjx7-w2jp and dependency-check/DependencyCheck#8749. Remove when NVD no longer maps this CVE onto kotlin-stdlib, or when the Boot BOM manages Kotlin 2.4.20+ and dependency-check is clean without this entry.
